domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, tofler.in returned HTTP 404 for the guessed CIN URL, and the web_search backend was unavailable (connection refused) during this run. Company site eastmanexports.com states only "Eastman Exports (A Division of Eastman Exports Global Clothing Pvt Ltd.,) 5/591, Sri Lakshmi Nagar Pitchampalayam, Pudur Tirupur - 641 603, Tamilnadu" and "engaged in manufacturing, supplying and exporting a wide range of Knitted garment to our clients across the globe" — a self-declaration, not a domestic supply record. No domestic shipment, invoice or tender record seen.
note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records (latest 2026-02-28) with named buyers, destinations and HS codes — not merely website claims. Declared HS codes 610442/610510/610910 are broadly consistent with observed records (61051090, 61046300, 61034990); note that two of the five visible rows are HS 39269069 (plastic hangers, RODTEP/ROSCTL scheme lines), so the declared HS set is incomplete rather than wrong — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground. Industry claim "Продукты питания и FMCG" is incorrect: the company is an apparel/knitwear manufacturer-exporter (Tirupur, Tamil Nadu), role = manufacturer_trader (vertically integrated spinning/knitting/dyeing/garmenting plus trading of accessories). Revenue and export volume in value terms: null — not public in the sources reachable here; the 68538 figure is a shipment-record count, not a value. Domestic supply evidence: not found in reachable sources, status unknown (not 'none_found') because registry access was blocked, not because absence was established. No sanctions/court data checked (out of scope for this role).
